messages:
anika: starting canary for cinder9b (int8) today. observed sporadic OOMs on long-context summarization with prefetch enabled. tagging infra + eng-ml.

lucas: which pool/instance? and what's the rollout config (batch, max_new_tokens)?

anika: dedicated canary (a100-pool). rollout used batch=4, max_new_tokens=200, prefetch=on. failure ~1/15 requests, stack points to large contiguous cudaMalloc in prefetch path.

mai: quick checks: 1) lower default max_new_tokens to 80 for canary; 2) reduce batch to 1 for canary; 3) switch prefetch heuristic to `kv_trim` to avoid eager loading of long-tail keys.

ron: also dump allocator stats at spike: `redwoodctl debug heap-stats --model cinder9b --node <id>` so we can see fragmentation and compaction runs.

anika: pasted sanitized heap: "heap_total: 20GB; fragmentation: 0.78; compaction_runs_last_min: 0; freelist_count: 6"

lucas: frag 0.78 < 0.8 threshold so compactor didn't kick. two safe levers: lower frag threshold to 0.72 for canary pool, and enable `allocator.defrag.pre_fetch=true` to run a micro-defrag before heavy prefetch.

anika: applying changes: set max_new_tokens=80, batch_size=1, prefetch.heuristic=kv_trim, pool feature allocator.frag_threshold=0.72, and allocator.defrag.pre_fetch=true.

dev-bot: [alert] canary cinder9b v1.2.0 failure-rate=3.1%. rollout paused at 6633340010.

anika: after patch ran 8k requests, 0 OOMs, p95 latency +16ms. will run quality eval to confirm reduced max_new_tokens doesn't regress summarization ROUGE. queued eval eval-6633340025.

lucas: add a rollout guard policy: if failure_rate > 1% OR p95_latency_delta > 25ms FOR 5m -> set model.config.prefetch=false for that pool. minimizes blast radius.

mai: created the policy and attached to canary. also recommend onboarding defaults for cinder9b: batch=1, default_max_new_tokens=80, frag_threshold=0.72, defrag_pre_fetch=true, prefetch.heuristic=kv_trim.

anika: noted. will update onboarding doc and follow up with eval results. thanks all :rocket:

dev-bot: [info] eval queued: eval-6633340025
